summary:
The latest changes add username/password authentication and complete the fixes for the previously reported migration and single-administrator authorization problems.
- Blocks account registration through the exposed Better Auth HTTP routes.
- Requires protected RPC sessions to match the provisioned administrator identity.
- Rebuilds the empty legacy auth tables before applying the current Better Auth schema.
- Adds authentication, migration, and end-to-end login coverage.
